tools.description: Rust-powered search that respects .gitignore while delivering grep-impossible speeds
tools.usage:
rg 'TODO|FIXME|XXX' --type rust # Hunt technical debt
rg -C3 'panic!' --type rust # Context around panics
rg --files-with-matches 'deprecated' | head -10 # Files needing updates
rg -U 'fn\s+\w+.*\{[^}]*panic' # Multiline function search
